COPY prompts /app/prompts
COPY config /app/config
COPY release/manifest.yaml /app/release/manifest.yaml
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
checks.note: The artifacts are supplied locally and copied into the image. The supplied tree has no git metadata, CODEOWNERS, branch protection or ruleset configuration, so tracking and coverage cannot be verified. A main-branch release condition does not establish independent approving review; hosting-service settings are unavailable. No demonstrably untracked artifact or review bypass was found.

The deployment names an owner and admission trusts images signed by the main-branch CI workflow, but neither defines who may change production configuration. CI publishes images and has no production deployment job, so its missing environment entry alone does not demonstrate an unprotected deployment. No CODEOWNERS, production IAM, Kubernetes writer RBAC or protected-environment role configuration is supplied; no broad writer grant or agent credential permitting production configuration changes was found.

Enumerated all agent files, including hidden workflow files, and searched for emergency, break-glass, review, follow-up, end-date and expiry terms; inspected README operating instructions, CI, manifest, deployment controls and database grants. The halt/resume mechanism controls run execution, not an emergency manifest or policy change. No emergency configuration-change path or procedure is supplied, so an external procedure and its required records remain unverifiable rather than a demonstrated incomplete emergency-change path.

note: The supplied repository evidence cannot establish independent change review, production configuration writer authorization or emergency-change records, and does not demonstrate a concrete violation of these checks.
